description.zh:
集合名。

> 您可以通过[ListCollections](~~2401503~~)接口查看列表。
description.en:
The name of the collection.

>  You can call the [ListCollections](~~2401503~~) operation to query a list of collections.

description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
The instance ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

description.zh: 上传向量数据的任务ID，由`UpsertCollectionDataAsync`接口获得。
description.en: The ID of the vector data upload job. You can call the `UpsertCollectionDataAsync` operation to query the job ID.

description.zh:
命名空间，默认为public。

> 您可以通过CreateNamespace接口创建，通过ListNamespaces接口查看列表。
description.en:
The name of the namespace. Default value: public.

>  You can call the CreateNamespace operation to create a namespace and call the ListNamespaces operation to query a list of namespaces.

description.zh:
命名空间对应的密码。

> 本值为CreateNamespace接口指定。
description.en:
The password of the namespace.

>  The value of this parameter is specified when you call the CreateNamespace operation.
The region ID of the instance.

description.zh: 多数据库实例组成的Workspace的Id。此参数和DBInstanceId参数不能同时为空，当和DBInstanceId同时指定时以此参数为准。
description.en: The ID of the workspace that consists of multiple AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances. You must specify one of the WorkspaceId and DBInstanceId parameters. If you specify both parameters, the WorkspaceId parameter takes effect.

title.zh: 取消异步上传向量数据任务

descriptions.zh:
此接口为`UpsertCollectionDataAsync`的相关接口。用于取消上传任务。


> 当任务已经处理成功、失败、已取消时，不能再次调用取消接口。调用取消接口仅中断上传任务，已经写的数据，需要用户自行或者调用DeleteCollectionData接口删除。
descriptions.en:
This operation is related to the `UpsertCollectionDataAsync` operation. You can call this operation to cancel an upload job.

>  If the canceling operation is complete, failed, or is canceled, you cannot call the operation again. The canceling operation only interrupts the upload job. To remove the uploaded data, you must manually remove it or call the DeleteCollectionData operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb cancel-upsert-collection-data-job --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --namespace mynamespace --collection document --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace-password testpassword --job-id bf8f7bc4-9276-44f7-9c22-1d06edc8dfd1 --workspace-id gp-ws-00000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb CancelUpsertCollectionDataJob --region cn-hangzhou --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --WorkspaceId 'gp-ws-00000' --Collection document --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --NamespacePassword testpassword --Namespace mynamespace --JobId 'bf8f7bc4-9276-44f7-9c22-1d06edc8dfd1'
